title: a non-transactional workflow that creates an aggregate and then fails a guard keeps nothing it created
note: Gate for D-PARENT-FIRST (docs/decisions).  A straight-line body saves at its exit on every backend, so a failing guard leaves nothing (docs/workflow.md).  Elixir inserted the created row where the body created it.
